purpose: Primary-source registry for recent literature that constrains or contextualizes RLL branches. Inclusion establishes relevance, not equivalence or validation.

sources.title: DESI 2024 VI: Cosmological Constraints from the Measurements of Baryon Acoustic Oscillations
sources.safe_use: Use DESI DR2 BAO measurements and official likelihood/covariance products; do not treat combination-dependent dark-energy preference as universal.

sources.title: Probing Generalized Emergent Dark Energy with DESI DR2
sources.safe_use: Conceptual and statistical comparator for emergent/transitional dark energy; not mathematically equivalent to RLL.

sources.title: Dissipative Cosmology and the Nature of Dark Energy: Insights from Bulk Viscosity with DESI DR2 observations
sources.safe_use: Supports a dissipative-fluid comparator and p_eff=p-3Hxi branch; it does not validate photonic viscosity.

sources.title: Interacting dark sectors in light of DESI DR2
sources.safe_use: Supports testing Q-coupled dark-sector branches at both background and perturbation levels.

sources.title: Testing the Anton-Schmidt dark energy model with the DESI DR2 measurements
sources.safe_use: Comparator for density-dependent late-time dark-fluid equations; not equivalent to the RLL logistic sector.

sources.title: Crosschecking cosmic distances from DESI BAO and DES SNe
sources.safe_use: Motivates a compatibility gate and method-sensitive reconstruction checks before joint inference.

sources.title: Directional Tests of the Cosmic Distance Duality Relation using Pantheon+ and BAO
sources.safe_use: Supports eta(z) diagnostics and survey-selection null tests; does not establish intrinsic anisotropy.

sources.title: Cross-correlation of CHIME FRB dispersion measures with DESI Legacy Survey galaxies
sources.safe_use: Supports an observational plasma-structure bridge; an RLL residual requires a prediction beyond standard nu^-2 dispersion.

sources.title: Fast Radio Burst Cosmology: Hubble Tension and Dark Energy
sources.safe_use: Use as review context for FRB cosmology and systematics; observational claims must cite underlying datasets.

sources.title: Cosmic Birefringence from the Atacama Cosmology Telescope Data Release 6
sources.safe_use: Supports a magneto-optical comparator; the reported 2.9-sigma rotation remains systematics-limited.

sources.title: Is cosmic birefringence due to dark energy or dark matter? Simulation-based inference
sources.safe_use: Comparator for distinguishing field origins of birefringence; not evidence for the RLL magnetic coupling.
